info.name: Salesforce Analytics (CRM Analytics) REST Actions Query API
Execute a Tooling API SOQL query

params.name: q
params.description: The SOQL query string targeting Tooling API objects (e.g., SELECT Id, FullName, Metadata FROM Flow WHERE Status = 'Active')

items.docs: Executes a SOQL query against Tooling API objects. Supports querying ApexClass, ApexTrigger, Flow, FlowDefinition, CustomField, ValidationRule, WorkflowRule, and other metadata types.
Executes a SAQL (Salesforce Analytics Query Language) query against CRM Analytics datasets. SAQL provides a SQL-like syntax for querying, aggregating, and transforming analytics data.
